nodes.title: TO ACTIVATE LORA INSTEAD OF PULID :
widgets_values:
This section is only for people that has already A lora model for a subject : 

1-DISABLE Pulid Node (use the switcher for that) (NEVER USE A CHARACTER LORA WITH A PULID)
Why, well it's simple it will confuse the AI cause there is 2 ID (one from Pulid and the other from Lora)
2-Reconnect model wire from "Lora Loader Stack" to Model in "LOAD DIFFUSION NODE"
3-Set the weight for your Lora (you can keep it to 1).
4-Well ? N'Joy ?

nodes.title: PREVIEW ONLY (Without any enhancement) (Yeah i know it's great :D, BUT look below, and prepare to Cry :p)
ADD LORA FOR STYLE CONCEPT ETC (WITH PULID OR ANOTHER SUBjECT LORA MODEL)
widgets_values:
Well well well, ok we can set a lora or Pulid for some magics, But what if i want to instead do the the same but add a special lora ?
well, i didn't forgot that :D (sometimes i'm a genius, sometime not lol) Follow this steps:
1-Follow the Note "TO ACTIVATE PULID", and then add a lora (whatever you want BUT, remember ? not a character model!) 
-> See the second note to know why .....you know it can cause your house on fire, birds and planes falling from the sky....Etc...
You don't want that right ? So let go to step 2..
2-For styles and concept and even other lora put it in second slot on the "Lora Stacker" don't put the weight to 1, 0.4-0.75 should be enough.
3-Enjoy !
Now let's talk about that : you want to add a character lora model instead of PULID BUT you want to apply lora style too..
Well, ok, remember when i said put the lora concept lora style in seconde slot and leave thefirst one empty ? 
And why the style lora or concept etc.... should be at 0.4-0.75 ? it is for that. a weight of 1 can affect (destroy) your lora character. Simple.
so ->
1) deactivate the Pulid Node see the 2nd note for that -> load your character to the first slot AND your wanted style in second slot.
2) Hit "Queue" and LET THE MAGIC COME TO YOU MY LITTLE WHITE RABBIT !

nodes.title: ORIGINAL CLONED RATIO AND CUSTOM RATIO (DIMENSION)
widgets_values:
The "COPY ORIGINAL SIZE" Node, is the key here.
1- To copy the original size -> Just link the "SPECTRAL CLONE TARGET" Image output to Image in "RATIO IMAGE SELECTOR".
2- Link Width / Height / Count to -> Width / Height / Count TO -> Width Override / Height Override / Batch Size to "RATIO IMAGE SELECTOR".
It will Override the default ratio image selector in "RATIO IMAGE SELECTOR" node.

Ok now, what if i want to get back in Default Ratio Selector ?
Just unlink (delete it) the Width Override / Height Override / Batch Size in "RATIO IMAGE SELECTOR".
There is a bug that the "RATIO IMAGE SELECTOR" with Red Links (it think it is always connected even after switching off the "COPY ORIGINAL RAITO IMAGE".
If you have that problem just right click on "RATIO IMAGE SELECTOR" and -> "FIX NODE" -> and you will be able to select a ratio for your image.

And Voila ! (Et vive la France !!)
